# use-ai

RustUse ai utilities and facade set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-ai/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-ai/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-ai/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-ai
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Parent RustUse links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
- Onboarding docs: https://rustuse.org/onboarding/
